chunks: Mūsā ibn Bakr said to al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام:
Indeed, our companions say that trimming the mustache and the nails is only on the day of Jumuʿah.
So he said, “Glory be to Allah! Take them if you wish on the day of Jumuʿah, and if you wish on the other days.”

key_terms.أَخْذُ: taking or trimming, here meaning cutting
key_terms.أَصْحَابَنَا: our companions; the community referred to by the speaker

ai.seo_question: Is trimming the mustache and nails only permitted or recommended on Friday in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states that trimming the mustache and nails is not restricted to Friday. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام rejects the idea of exclusivity and allows doing so on Jumuʿah or on any other day. The report concerns personal cleanliness and the flexibility of its timing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.313 - Musa ibn Bakr said to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as):
"Our companions say that trimming the mustache and nails is only on Jumu’ah."
Imam (as) replied: "Glory be to Allah (swt)! Trim them if you wish on Jumu’ah, or if you wish, on any other day."
